DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.

Given your age, significant weight loss, and classic obstructive jaundice signs (pale stools, dark urine) after a history of chronic alcohol use, the most likely cause is a tumor in the head of the pancreas blocking the bile duct. Immediate imaging is required to confirm the location and extent of the blockage.
